items.title: Book Publishers Are Quietly Using More AI. Staff Are Revolting
items.summary: Workers at three major publishing houses tell WIRED that LLMs are being used for publicity, cover art, back cover copy, and emails, as some execs push junior staff to champion the tech.
items.author: Adam Morgan

items.title: Even ‘Law & Order’ Is Terrified of AI
items.summary: In its 26th season premiere, the procedural legal drama paints a damning picture of power-mad AI CEOs.
items.author: Ej Dickson
